# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [ChatGPT for Teens Adds Default Age-Based Safeguards](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/chatgpt-teens-default-safeguards.html): OpenAI launched a dedicated experience that automatically places identified 13-to-17-year-olds behind stronger safety and learning controls.
- [Claude Opus 5 Designs Protein Binders in Lab Test](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-designs-protein-binders.html): Anthropic tested Claude-designed protein binders in the laboratory and released the experiment’s prompts, data and technical report.
- [OpenAI Pauses Frontier Training Over Astra Cyber Risk](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-pauses-training-astra-cyber-risk.html): OpenAI has slowed frontier development after its unreleased Astra model showed signs of critical offensive cyber capability.
- [Tripo P2.0 Generates Quad Meshes for Game Pipelines](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tripo-p2-quad-game-meshes.html): Tripo’s new 3D preview generates native quad topology with up to 25,000 quads, targeting characters and real-time production assets.
- [Amazon Scans and Destroys Books for AI Training](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/amazon-scans-destroys-rare-books.html): A tracked shipment exposed an Amazon operation that buys, disassembles and scans physical books to obtain AI-training material.
- [Cursor Launches Origin, Its GitHub Alternative](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-launches-origin-code-hosting.html): Cursor is expanding from AI coding into repository infrastructure, bringing code, agents and deployment integrations under one roof.
- [Groq Raises $650M to Expand Its AI Inference Cloud](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/groq-funds-neocloud-pivot.html): Groq’s latest official financing was a $650 million round co-led by Disruptive and Infinitum, supporting expansion of its global inference cloud.
- [Higgsfield Raises $400M at a $5.4B Valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/higgsfield-raises-video-ai-round.html): The generative-media company has secured a major round to scale its video and image platform amid intensifying AIGC competition.
- [Alibaba Brings QwenWork Agent Into Tencent’s WeCom](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwenwork-enters-tencent-wecom.html): QwenWork can now operate through WeCom chats, taking Alibaba’s workplace agent into the heart of Tencent’s enterprise ecosystem.
- [Meshy Details Its Alignment Method for Image-to-3D](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meshy-7-technical-report.html): Meshy’s new technical report explains how its latest system more faithfully transfers a reference image into usable 3D geometry.
- [Stripe Reportedly Agrees to Acquire OpenRouter for More Than $8 Billion](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/stripe-nears-openrouter-acquisition.html): The reported agreement would combine AI model routing, usage metering and payments in one powerful infrastructure provider, although the companies have not publicly announced the deal.
- [Alibaba’s Qwen Models Cross Three Billion Downloads](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/qwen-crosses-three-billion-downloads.html): Qwen’s download milestone signals that the center of gravity in open-weight AI is shifting toward China’s developer ecosystem.
- [Anthropic Withholds Stronger Model as Risk Estimates Rise](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-withholds-riskier-model.html): Anthropic’s latest risk report raises its misalignment estimate and says a stronger internal model will not be released for now.
- [Google Makes Visible Gemini and Flow Media Watermarks Optional in Most Markets](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-optional-visible-watermarks.html): Users in most markets can remove visible marks from generated images, video and music, while Google retains SynthID and C2PA provenance; legally required marks remain in some jurisdictions.
- [METR Secures $71 Million to Scale Independent AI Tests](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/metr-raises-independent-ai-testing-funds.html): The nonprofit evaluator will expand research on autonomous capabilities and AI-driven self-improvement while rejecting lab funding.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [ChatGPT 推出青少年专属模式，安全限制默认开启](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/chatgpt-teens-default-safeguards.html): OpenAI 面向13至17岁用户推出独立体验，系统识别为未成年人的账户将自动启用更严格的学习与安全保护。
- [Claude Opus 5 参与蛋白结合物设计并接受实验验证](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-designs-protein-binders.html): Anthropic 将 Claude Opus 5 生成的蛋白结合物方案送入实验室验证，并公开技术报告、提示词与实验数据。
- [Astra 显现关键级网络能力，OpenAI 暂缓前沿训练](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-pauses-training-astra-cyber-risk.html): 未发布模型 Astra 在测试中显现关键级网络攻击能力后，OpenAI 暂停部分强化学习训练并全面提高研发环境安全门槛。
- [Tripo P2.0 预览版直出四边面，瞄准游戏资产生产](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tripo-p2-quad-game-meshes.html): Tripo 推出可生成原生四边面拓扑的 P2.0 预览版，最高支持2.5万四边面，重点服务角色与实时游戏资产。
- [亚马逊被曝拆毁稀缺图书，为 AI 训练获取扫描文本](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/amazon-scans-destroys-rare-books.html): 一批装有追踪器的图书揭开亚马逊训练数据供应链：实体书被批量购入、拆解并扫描，原件随之损毁。
- [Cursor 推出代码托管平台 Origin，正面切入 GitHub 腹地](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-launches-origin-code-hosting.html): Cursor 从 AI 编程工具进一步扩展至代码仓库基础设施，试图把代码、智能体和部署集成纳入同一平台。
- [Groq 融资6.5亿美元，扩张AI推理云](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/groq-funds-neocloud-pivot.html): Groq 最新正式融资为6.5亿美元，由 Disruptive 与 Infinitum 共同领投，用于扩大全球推理云基础设施。
- [Higgsfield 融资 4 亿美元，估值升至 54 亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/higgsfield-raises-video-ai-round.html): 这家生成式媒体公司获得大额融资，将扩张视频与图像平台，迎战持续升温的全球 AIGC 竞争。
- [阿里千问办公接入企业微信，跨入腾讯办公生态](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwenwork-enters-tencent-wecom.html): 千问办公现可通过企业微信机器人直接响应员工请求，阿里由此把办公智能体带入腾讯主导的企业协作入口。
- [Meshy 7 技术报告披露图像转 3D 对齐方法](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meshy-7-technical-report.html): Meshy 发布新技术报告，解释最新系统如何把参考图中的比例、结构与关键部件更准确地还原为可用三维几何体。
- [Stripe据报同意逾80亿美元收购OpenRouter](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/stripe-nears-openrouter-acquisition.html): 据报双方已签署收购协议，潜在交易将把模型路由、用量计费与支付整合到同一家基础设施服务商手中，但两家公司尚未公开宣布交易。
- [阿里千问模型全球下载量突破30亿次](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/qwen-crosses-three-billion-downloads.html): 千问下载量跨过30亿次，显示全球开放权重模型的开发者生态正加速向中国模型倾斜。
- [Anthropic上调失控风险评估，暂不发布更强内部模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-withholds-riskier-model.html): Anthropic在最新风险报告中上调高风险场景下的模型失控概率判断，并确认暂不发布能力更强的内部“Model 2”。
- [谷歌在多数市场开放关闭Gemini与Flow可见水印，SynthID仍将保留](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-optional-visible-watermarks.html): 多数市场的用户可关闭生成图片、视频和音乐上的可见水印，但谷歌仍会保留SynthID和C2PA来源信息；法律要求显示标识的地区不适用。
- [METR获7100万美元承诺资金，扩充独立AI评测](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/metr-raises-independent-ai-testing-funds.html): 这家非营利评测机构将扩大自主能力与AI自我改进研究，并重申不接受前沿模型公司的资金。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-19.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
